user.title: Tapo doorbell
user.description: How do you want to add the doorbell?

menu_options.discover: Find it: I'll press the doorbell

not_found.title: No doorbell found
not_found.description: No press came in. Check that Home Assistant is on the same network/VLAN as the doorbell (a VM needs a bridged network adapter) and that UDP port 20005 is not blocked.

found.title: Doorbell found
found.description: Found a doorbell at {host}. Tip: give it a fixed IP in your router.

manual.title: Tapo doorbell
manual.description: Home Assistant must be on the same network/VLAN, because presses arrive as a UDP broadcast on port 20005.

camera.title: Photo on ring (optional)
camera.description: Fill in the camera account to get a photo at every press. Create it in the Tapo app: doorbell → Settings → Advanced settings → Camera account. This is NOT your TP-Link login. Leave empty to skip.

progress.wait_press: Press the doorbell button now. Waiting up to {timeout} seconds…

error.incomplete_credentials: Fill in both username and password, or leave both empty
error.cannot_snapshot: Could not get a photo. Check the camera account and that RTSP (port 554) is reachable.

abort.already_configured: This doorbell is already set up

init.title: Doorbell settings
init.description: Leave the camera account empty to turn photos off.

error.incomplete_credentials: Fill in both username and password, or leave both empty
error.cannot_snapshot: Could not get a photo. Check the camera account and that RTSP (port 554) is reachable.
